changes.xmldata.room_description: Crushed between the sheer walls of the chasm, the winding mountain trail twists and turns without reason amidst piles of snow-covered boulders.  Visibility, hampered by blinding clouds of wind-blown snow, leaves much to be desired.  As soon as one massive drift of snow is conquered, another awaits around the next bend.  The bitter cold of the gorge offers little warmth and comfort and the stone mountains glare icily down upon travelers.

changes.xmldata.room_description: Night covers the narrow gorge with an impenetrable veil of darkness.  The inky blackness devours the remotest hint of shape or shadow, and nothing is distinguishable in the black void at the bottom of the chasm.  Fragments of lose rock and ice dislodged by the winds plunge unseen into deep snow drifts with thunderous crashes.
